purpose: V4 premium pixel-art stage concept to test improved castle, wall, sky and floor readability against Mega Drive palette and tile budgets; not final native pixel art
prompt: Redraw this concept as an ORIGINAL premium 1990s 16-bit arcade fighting-game background. Preserve the ultra-wide 640:224 panoramic layout and broad anchors (moonlit night, clouds, Japanese castle, long wall, foreground fighting platform), but replace the simple blockout with rich, intentional pixel art: a multi-tier castle with ornate roof eaves and lit windows; layered stone ramparts and crenellations; distant mountain silhouettes; varied cloud forms; a wooden rail with crafted joints; large platform slabs, seams and a few restrained lanterns. Crisp pixels with deliberate clusters and strong material separation, no anti-aliasing, blur, painterly texture, smooth gradients, text, logos, characters, HUD or UI. Keep large readable silhouettes behind two fighters and reserve the top 56 pixels for HUD. Use at most 8 visible colors: deep navy, blue-violet, muted stone/lavender, pale moonlight, and controlled red-orange accents. Favor repeated tile motifs and clean shapes over noisy detail so Mega Drive 8x8 tile reuse remains feasible. Concept exploration only, not final hardware-ready pixel art.
